jobs.description:
Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 31 offices in financial centres worldwide, and employs over 5,100 people.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial services group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families, including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

UK PWM provides investment services such as execution-only, advisory, and discretionary management services to clients in domestic and international markets including UK, Eastern Europe and Middle East.

A position is open for a Business Oversight Manager for UK PWM. The Business Oversight Manager is a key role in the Management Team reporting to the head of Business Oversight for UK PWM.

The Business Oversight Team supports the COO in the execution of a broad range of activities, including risk management, operations, outsourcing, project management, sales and pipeline management, financial and regulatory reporting etc. The role has a particular focus on data analytics and risk/control activities.

Your role

• Ownership of the execution of the Consumer Duty framework, including fair value assessments, qualitative and quantitative testing against defined good outcomes, vulnerable clients analysis and assessments.

• Responsible for the execution of business control and oversight activities including sample testing, data analytics, and review of output from centralised control functions, with the goal of confirming compliance with UK regulatory requirements and firm policies.

• Reporting of results to the COO and development of proposals to remediate findings and improve our ways of working.

• Provide input to the development of the London Branch oversight framework, including the development of new activities and opportunities for efficiency.

• Support the CEO of London Branch by providing regular and ad-hoc sales management data analysis and reporting, including book analysis, revenue analysis etc.

• Support the Head of Business Oversight and COO in the preparation of materials for governance meetings and regulatory reporting (e.g. Executive Committee and Consumer Duty Board Report).

• Participate in periodic reviews and projects, including new products/services and regulatory implementations.

• Manage and develop access to key data/information sources of the London Branch (including tableaus/system extracts and other means).

• Assist in preparation of response to regulatory/audit enquiries.

Your profile

• The role requires interactions with many different functions of the firm from Relationship Managers and Investment Specialists in the front office to Compliance, Finance, Operations and Technology. The ideal candidate should be able to interact effectively with these functions and stakeholder manage.

• The role has a wide and interesting scope, requiring candidates to have at least 3 years prior experience in wealth management or similar role.

• The role has a particular focus on data analytics and risk/control activities, therefore EXCEL skills (formulae) and experience handling larger sets of data are essential.

• Degree educated (or equivalent). Numerical or IT discipline preferred e.g. accounting, economics, finance.

• Motivated, proactive and energetic self-starter who takes ownership.

• Detail oriented with an investigative mindset, coupled with strong ability to critically analyse data and produce accurate, reconcilable output. Be able to take judgement.

• Good organizational skills - manage and prioritise multiple tasks across different time horizons within deadlines.

• Knowledge/experience of wealth management services and investment products, as well as wealth management regulatory landscape.

• Excellent MS skills, in particular Excel and PowerPoint. Interest in AI developments.

The ideal candidate will have existing experience working within risk or compliance of a UK wealth manager and have a strong interest in developing a career within this industry. They will be proactive and organised with an eye for detail, be able to efficiently and critically analyse data, and produce quality output.

Note

We will not accept any CVs via agencies

Diversity & Inclusion

Pictet is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a diverse environment. We respect all individuals and seek their inclusion in the workplace.

La tua squadra

Il Gruppo Pictet è uno dei principali asset manager indipendenti al mondo. Fondato nel 1805 e con sede a Ginevra, in Svizzera, il Gruppo è rappresentato a 31 uffici nei centri finanziari di tutto il mondo e impiega oltre 5.100 persone.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combina oltre 200 anni di patrimonio bancario svizzero con competenze di investimento globali. Il gruppo di servizi finanziari di proprietà del Partner offre un servizio completo per persone e famiglie ricche, tra cui soluzioni di investimento discrezionali e consultive e servizi di ufficio familiare.

UK PWM fornisce servizi di investimento come servizi di esecuzione, consulenza e gestione discrezionale ai clienti nei mercati nazionali e internazionali, tra cui Regno Unito, Europa orientale e Medio Oriente.

Una posizione è aperta per un Business Oversight Manager per UK PWM. Il Business Oversight Manager è un ruolo chiave nel reporting del team di gestione alla testa di Business Oversight per UK PWM.

Il Business Oversight Team supporta il COO nell'esecuzione di una vasta gamma di attività, tra cui la gestione del rischio, le operazioni, l'outsourcing, la gestione del progetto, la gestione delle vendite e delle tubazioni, la rendicontazione finanziaria e regolamentare ecc. Il ruolo ha un particolare focus sulle attività di analisi dei dati e di controllo del rischio.

Il tuo ruolo

• Proprietà dell'esecuzione del framework Consumer Duty, tra cui valutazioni di fair value, test qualitativi e quantitativi contro i buoni risultati definiti, analisi e valutazioni dei clienti vulnerabili.

• Responsabile per l'esecuzione di attività di controllo aziendale e supervisione, tra cui test di campionamento, analisi dei dati e revisione dell'output da funzioni di controllo centralizzate, con l'obiettivo di confermare la conformità ai requisiti normativi e alle politiche aziendali del Regno Unito.

• Relazione dei risultati al COO e sviluppo di proposte volte a correggere i risultati e migliorare le nostre modalità di lavoro.

• Fornire input allo sviluppo del quadro di supervisione di London Branch, tra cui lo sviluppo di nuove attività e opportunità di efficienza.

• Sostenere il CEO di London Branch fornendo analisi e report periodici e ad-hoc di gestione delle vendite, tra cui l'analisi del libro, l'analisi delle entrate ecc.

• Sostenere il capo della supervisione aziendale e del COO nella preparazione dei materiali per le riunioni di governance e le relazioni regolamentari (ad esempio il comitato esecutivo e il rapporto del consiglio di amministrazione dei consumatori).

• Partecipa a revisioni e progetti periodici, inclusi nuovi prodotti/servizi e implementazioni normative.

• Gestire e sviluppare l'accesso a fonti di dati/informazioni chiave del London Branch (compresi estratti di tableaus/system e altri mezzi).

• Assistere in preparazione alla risposta alle richieste di controllo/audit.

Il tuo profilo

• Il ruolo richiede interazioni con molte diverse funzioni dell'azienda da Relationship Managers e Investment Specialists in front office a Compliance, Finance, Operations and Technology. Il candidato ideale dovrebbe essere in grado di interagire efficacemente con queste funzioni e gestione degli stakeholder.

• Il ruolo ha un ampio e interessante ambito, che richiede ai candidati di avere almeno 3 anni di esperienza precedente nella gestione della ricchezza o ruolo simile.

• Il ruolo ha un particolare focus sulle attività di analisi dei dati e di controllo, quindi le competenze EXCEL (formulae) e la gestione delle esperienze più grandi set di dati sono essenziali.

• Laurea educata (o equivalente). La disciplina numerica o IT preferiva ad esempio contabilità, economia, finanza.

• Motivato, proattivo ed energico autostarter che prende la proprietà.

• Particolare orientato con una mentalità investigativa, unita alla forte capacità di analizzare criticamente i dati e produrre output accurati e riconciliabili. Sii in grado di giudicare.

• Buone capacità organizzative - gestire e dare priorità a molteplici compiti in diversi orizzonti temporali entro le scadenze.

• Conoscenza/esperienza dei servizi di gestione della ricchezza e dei prodotti di investimento, così come il paesaggio regolamentare della gestione della ricchezza.

• Competenze di MS eccellenti, in particolare Excel e PowerPoint. Interessi sugli sviluppi dell'IA.

Il candidato ideale avrà esperienza esistente lavorando all'interno del rischio o della conformità di un gestore di ricchezza del Regno Unito e avrà un forte interesse a sviluppare una carriera all'interno di questo settore. Saranno proattivi e organizzati con un occhio per i dettagli, in grado di analizzare in modo efficiente e critico i dati e produrre risultati di qualità.

Nota

Non accetteremo alcun CV tramite agenzie

Diversità e inclusione

Pictet è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità e si impegna a creare un ambiente diverso. Rispettiamo tutti gli individui e cerchiamo la loro inclusione nel posto di lavoro.

Dein Team

Die Pictet Group ist einer der weltweit führenden unabhängigen Vermögensverwalter. Die 1805 gegründete Gruppe mit Hauptsitz in Genf, Schweiz, ist in 31 Büros in Finanzzentren weltweit vertreten und beschäftigt über 5.100 Mitarbeiter.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) verbindet mehr als 200 Jahre Schweizer Bankerbe mit globaler Investmentexpertise. Die Partner-eigene Finanzdienstleistungsgruppe bietet einen umfassenden Service für wohlhabende Einzelpersonen und Familien, einschließlich diskretionärer und beratender Anlagelösungen und Family Office-Services.

UK PWM erbringt Investmentdienstleistungen wie reine Ausführungs-, Beratungs- und diskretionäre Managementdienstleistungen für Kunden in nationalen und internationalen Märkten, einschließlich Großbritannien, Osteuropa und Nahost.

Eine Stelle ist offen für einen Business Oversight Manager für UK PWM. Der Business Oversight Manager ist eine Schlüsselrolle im Management-Team und berichtet dem Head of Business Oversight für UK PWM.

Das Business Oversight Team unterstützt den COO bei der Durchführung einer breiten Palette von Aktivitäten, darunter Risikomanagement, Operations, Outsourcing, Projektmanagement, Vertriebs- und Pipelinemanagement, Finanz- und Regulierungsberichterstattung usw. Die Rolle hat einen besonderen Fokus auf Datenanalyse und Risiko- / Kontrollaktivitäten.

Deine Rolle

• Eigentum an der Ausführung des Rahmens für Verbrauchersteuern, einschließlich Bewertungen des beizulegenden Zeitwerts, qualitativer und quantitativer Tests anhand definierter guter Ergebnisse, Analysen und Bewertungen schutzbedürftiger Kunden.

• Verantwortlich für die Durchführung von Geschäftskontroll- und Aufsichtstätigkeiten, einschließlich Stichprobentests, Datenanalysen und Überprüfung der Ergebnisse zentralisierter Kontrollfunktionen, mit dem Ziel, die Einhaltung der britischen regulatorischen Anforderungen und verbindlichen Richtlinien zu bestätigen.

• Berichterstattung über die Ergebnisse an den COO und Entwicklung von Vorschlägen zur Behebung der Ergebnisse und zur Verbesserung unserer Arbeitsweise.

• Bereitstellung von Beiträgen zur Entwicklung des Aufsichtsrahmens für die Londoner Niederlassung, einschließlich der Entwicklung neuer Tätigkeiten und Möglichkeiten zur Effizienz.

• Unterstützen Sie den CEO der Londoner Niederlassung durch regelmäßige und Ad-hoc-Datenanalyse und -berichterstattung zum Verkaufsmanagement, einschließlich Buchanalyse, Umsatzanalyse usw.

• Unterstützen Sie den Head of Business Oversight und COO bei der Vorbereitung von Materialien für Governance-Meetings und regulatorische Berichterstattung (z. B. Executive Committee und Consumer Duty Board Report).

• Nehmen Sie an regelmäßigen Überprüfungen und Projekten teil, einschließlich neuer Produkte / Dienstleistungen und regulatorischer Implementierungen.

• Verwalten und entwickeln Sie den Zugang zu wichtigen Daten / Informationsquellen der Londoner Niederlassung (einschließlich Tableaus / Systemauszüge und andere Mittel).

• Unterstützung bei der Vorbereitung von Antworten auf regulatorische / Audit-Anfragen.

Dein Profil

• Die Rolle erfordert Interaktionen mit vielen verschiedenen Funktionen des Unternehmens von Relationship Managern und Investmentspezialisten im Front Office bis hin zu Compliance, Finanzen, Betrieb und Technologie. Der ideale Kandidat sollte in der Lage sein, effektiv mit diesen Funktionen zu interagieren und die Stakeholder zu verwalten.

• Die Rolle hat einen breiten und interessanten Umfang, so dass die Kandidaten mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in der Vermögensverwaltung oder einer ähnlichen Rolle haben müssen.

• Die Rolle hat einen besonderen Fokus auf Datenanalyse und Risiko- / Kontrollaktivitäten, daher sind EXCEL-Fähigkeiten (Formeln) und Erfahrung im Umgang mit größeren Datensätzen unerlässlich.

• Grad ausgebildet (oder gleichwertig). Numerische oder IT-Disziplin bevorzugt z.B. Buchhaltung, Wirtschaft, Finanzen.

• Motivierter, proaktiver und energetischer Selbststarter, der Verantwortung übernimmt.

• Detailorientiert mit einer investigativen Denkweise, gepaart mit einer starken Fähigkeit, Daten kritisch zu analysieren und genaue, vereinbare Ergebnisse zu erzielen. Seien Sie in der Lage, ein Urteil zu fällen.

• Gute organisatorische Fähigkeiten - Verwalten und Priorisieren mehrerer Aufgaben über verschiedene Zeithorizonte innerhalb von Fristen.

• Wissen/Erfahrung über Vermögensverwaltungsdienstleistungen und Anlageprodukte sowie die Regulierungslandschaft im Bereich Vermögensverwaltung.

• Hervorragende MS-Fähigkeiten, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint. Interesse an KI Entwicklungen.

Der ideale Kandidat wird über vorhandene Erfahrung im Bereich Risiko oder Compliance eines britischen Vermögensverwalters verfügen und ein starkes Interesse daran haben, eine Karriere in dieser Branche zu entwickeln. Sie werden proaktiv und mit Blick auf Details organisiert sein, in der Lage sein, Daten effizient und kritisch zu analysieren und qualitativ hochwertige Ergebnisse zu erzielen.

Le groupe Pictet est l'un des leaders mondiaux en matière de gestion de patrimoine et d'actifs. Fondé en 1805 et ayant son siège social à Genève, le Groupe est représenté dans 31 bureaux dans les centres financiers du monde entier et emploie plus de 5 100 personnes.

Pictet Wealth Management (PWM) combine plus de 200 ans d'héritage bancaire suisse avec une expertise mondiale en investissement. Le groupe de services financiers appartenant à des partenaires offre un service complet aux personnes et aux familles fortunées, y compris des solutions d'investissement discrétionnaires et consultatives et des services de bureau familial.

UK PWM fournit des services d'investissement tels que des services d'exécution, de conseil et de gestion discrétionnaire aux clients sur les marchés nationaux et internationaux, y compris au Royaume-Uni, en Europe de l'Est et au Moyen-Orient.

Un poste est ouvert à un responsable de la surveillance des entreprises pour le UK PWM. Le directeur de la surveillance des entreprises joue un rôle clé au sein de l'équipe de gestion qui relève du chef de la surveillance des entreprises pour PWM britannique.

L'équipe de surveillance des activités appuie le Bureau dans l'exécution d'un large éventail d'activités, notamment la gestion des risques, les opérations, l'externalisation, la gestion de projet, la gestion des ventes et des pipelines, les rapports financiers et réglementaires, etc. Ce rôle est particulièrement axé sur l'analyse des données et les activités de risque/contrôle.

Votre rôle

• Propriété de l'exécution du cadre des droits des consommateurs, y compris les évaluations de la juste valeur, les tests qualitatifs et quantitatifs par rapport aux bons résultats définis, les analyses et les évaluations des clients vulnérables.

• Responsable de l'exécution des activités de contrôle et de surveillance des entreprises, y compris les essais par sondage, l'analyse des données et l'examen des résultats des fonctions centralisées de contrôle, dans le but de confirmer le respect des exigences réglementaires et des politiques fermes du Royaume-Uni.

• Rapports des résultats au chef de l'exploitation et élaboration de propositions visant à corriger les constatations et à améliorer nos méthodes de travail.

• Contribuer à l'élaboration du cadre de surveillance de la Direction générale de Londres, y compris à l'élaboration de nouvelles activités et de nouvelles possibilités d'efficacité.

• Appuyer le PDG de London Branch en fournissant des analyses et des rapports réguliers et ad hoc sur la gestion des ventes, y compris des analyses de livres, des analyses de revenus, etc.

• Aider le chef de la surveillance opérationnelle et le chef de la direction à préparer des documents pour les réunions sur la gouvernance et les rapports réglementaires (p. ex., rapport du Comité exécutif et du Conseil des droits des consommateurs).

• Participer aux examens et projets périodiques, y compris les nouveaux produits et services et les mises en oeuvre réglementaires.

• Gérer et développer l'accès aux principales sources de données et d'information de la Direction générale de Londres (y compris les tableaux/extraits de système et autres moyens).

• Aider à préparer la réponse aux demandes de renseignements en matière de réglementation et de vérification.

Votre profil

• Le rôle exige des interactions avec de nombreuses fonctions différentes de l'entreprise, depuis les gestionnaires de relations et les spécialistes de l'investissement au bureau principal jusqu'à la conformité, les finances, les opérations et la technologie. Le candidat idéal devrait pouvoir interagir efficacement avec ces fonctions et gérer les intervenants.

• Le rôle a une portée vaste et intéressante, exigeant que les candidats aient au moins 3 ans d'expérience dans la gestion de patrimoine ou un rôle similaire.

• Le rôle a un accent particulier sur l'analyse des données et les activités de risque/contrôle, par conséquent les compétences EXCEL (formules) et l'expérience de traitement de plus grands ensembles de données sont essentielles.

• Diplôme (ou équivalent). Discipline numérique ou informatique préférée, p. ex. comptabilité, économie, finances.

• Motivé, proactif et énergique auto-démarrer qui prend possession.

• Les détails sont orientés vers un état d'esprit d'investigation, associés à une forte capacité d'analyse critique des données et de production précise et conciliable. Être capable de juger.

• Bonnes compétences organisationnelles - gérer et hiérarchiser plusieurs tâches à différents horizons dans les délais.

• Connaissance/expérience des services de gestion de patrimoine et des produits d'investissement, ainsi que du paysage réglementaire de la gestion de patrimoine.

• Excellentes compétences en MS, en particulier Excel et PowerPoint. Intérêt pour l'évolution de l'IA.

Le candidat idéal aura l'expérience existante de travailler dans le cadre du risque ou de la conformité d'un gestionnaire de patrimoine britannique et aura un fort intérêt à développer une carrière dans ce secteur. Your team

The Pictet Group is one of the world’s leading independent wealth and asset managers. Founded in 1805 and headquartered in Geneva, Switzerland, the Group is represented at 30 offices in financial centres worldwide, and currently employs over 5200 people. Pictet has been present since 1989 in Luxembourg, where it employs over 700 people.

FundPartner Solutions provides a full suite of fund administration and private label funds services. The global team of industry experts specialises in fund domiciliation, registration and governance, as well as risk compliance and investment management services.

Pictet Asset Services provides custody, fund services and trading solutions for external asset managers, fund managers and institutional clients. We manage every aspect of the asset servicing value chain and our range of bespoke solutions include value-adding analytics, trading strategy support and digital front-end interfaces designed to provide an unrivalled customer experience.

The position is based within the Fund Domiciliation team in Luxembourg and reports to the Head of Governance Solutions & Domiciliation.

Your role

As part of the Fund Domiciliation team, you will be responsible for supporting our clients, including Pictet funds and third-party funds, in all aspects of corporate governance and company secretarial matters throughout the lifecycle of the entities.

• Monitor and manage the corporate life cycle of administered funds.

• Prepare and file all required documentation with the relevant authorities and regulatory bodies (RCS, CSSF, LBR, etc.).

• Draft documentation related to Annual General Meetings (AGMs) and ensure their proper organisation and execution.

• Assist legal counsel in the organisation and conduct of ordinary and extraordinary general meetings.

• Maintain and update legal documentation, including collecting signatures, updating records, researching and identifying documents, and distributing documentation to internal departments and external authorities.

• Coordinate communications and mailings to shareholders and unitholders.

• Manage fund-related data and legal documentation within the document management and archiving systems.

• Prepare listing applications and ensure follow-up of listings on the Luxembourg Stock Exchange.

• Perform daily screening controls related to domiciliation activities.

Your profile

Requested experience:

• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent BAC+3) in Economics, Law, Finance, or a related field.

• Minimum of 2 years of experience in fund domiciliation activities.

Technical skills:

• Strong knowledge of the legal and regulatory frameworks applicable to the European investment funds industry (UCITS and AIFs) and their practical application throughout the corporate life cycle.

• Excellent understanding of the Luxembourg fund industry and other international fund jurisdictions.

• Strong proficiency in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Soft skills:

• Strong organisational and administrative skills.

• Attention to detail and accuracy.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines.

• Excellent communication and coordination skills.

Language skills:

• French:fluent

• English: fluent

In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

In this role, you will work closely with local sales teams, product specialists and central marketing teams to develop and deliver targeted initiatives that strengthen client engagement, support commercial priorities and raise Pictet AM's profile in Germany.

• developing and maintaining the annual marketing plan for Germany.

• acting as the primary marketing contact for the German business and coordinating local stakeholders.

• managing relationships with local agencies and external service providers.

• adapting and activating marketing content for the local market.

• managing the delivery of events, digital campaigns and client engagement initiatives.

• coordinating CRM-supported marketing activities and maintaining up-to-date client segmentation.

• contributing to regional and global marketing projects.

• supporting local brand development.

• sharing insights into the German market, lessons learned from campaigns and best practices with central teams.

Your team

Pictet Wealth Management combines more than 200 years of Swiss banking heritage with global investment expertise. The Partner-owned financial service group offers a comprehensive service for wealthy individuals and families including discretionary and advisory investment solutions and family office services.

We are looking for a Fund Analyst to join our cross-asset Funds Research & Advisory team, covering the Global Equity and Fixed Income pod with an extended remit into Liquid Alternatives. This is an opportunity to work within a T-shaped analyst model — developing deep expertise in your core asset classes while contributing to cross-pod initiatives, governance frameworks, and firm-wide manager research output.

You will play a key role in fund selection, manager due diligence, and portfolio construction support, feeding directly into our Approved and Focus List governance process.

Your role

• Conduct qualitative and quantitative due diligence on Global Equity and Fixed Income funds, with additional coverage of Liquid Alternatives strategies (equity long/short, global macro, multi-strategy, market neutral, relative value).
• Maintain and update fund ratings, ensuring alignment with the fund research governance.
• Prepare manager meeting notes, due diligence reports, and recommendations for Approved/Focus List reviews and Discretionary PMs.
• Monitor fund performance, risk characteristics, and portfolio positioning against stated mandates and peer groups.
• Support the Funds Advisory function and Discretionary Mandates by translating research views into actionable guidance for the front office.
• Contribute to thematic research pieces and quarterly manager survey presentations as well as requests.
• Liaise directly with fund management companies (portfolio managers, product specialists) on strategy updates, liquidity terms, and operational due diligence points.
• Support regulatory and cross-border fund considerations (UCITS, AIFMD) relevant to fund selection and distribution.
• Deputise for pod colleagues as needed and contribute to cross-pod knowledge sharing.

Your profile

• Master's degree in Finance, Economics, or related field CFA (or progress toward), CAIA a plus given Liquid Alternatives focus.
• At least ten years 10 years in fund research, manager selection, or fund analyst role within a private bank, asset manager, fund-of-funds, or investment consultancy.
• Demonstrated experience covering Liquid Alternatives strategies (hedge fund style, UCITS-wrapped or offshore) alongside traditional long-only equity and/or fixed income funds.
• Solid understanding of the fund management business — how asset managers are structured, fee models, distribution channels, and operational due diligence considerations.
• Familiarity with fund governance frameworks (rating systems, approved lists, investment committees) is a strong plus.
• Fluent in English; French a strong asset given client and internal stakeholder base.
• Strong quantitative due diligence skills: performance attribution, risk decomposition, factor analysis.
• Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks (UCITS, AIFMD; Swiss LPCC/LSFin knowledge a plus).
• Comfortable with fund research tools/databases (e.g., Morningstar Direct, Factset, Bloomberg).
• Advanced Excel; PowerPoint proficiency for client- and committee-facing materials.
• Excellent written and verbal communication, able to distill complex fund analysis into clear recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
• Comfortable engaging directly with fund managers and internal stakeholders.
• Collaborative mindset, able to work within a pod structure and contribute beyond a single asset class silo.
• Must be resident in Switzerland with a valid work permit.

Il tuo ruolo
